title: [Bug]: mysql container Unable to start
body:
### Module

MySQL

### Testcontainers version

1.20.6

### Using the latest Testcontainers version?

Yes

### Host OS

windows

### Host Arch

x64

### Docker version

```shell
Docker Desktop 4.40.0
```

### What happened?

mysql image 9.3 Unable to start

Some system variables have been removed
